Infrastructure Engineer 
 Summary 
 Location: Cluj (Hybrid) 
 Day Rate: Negotiable 
 Duration: 12 Months (with a potential view to extend further or convert to a permanent role) 
 Availability: ASAP
 About the Client 
 My client is the air transport industry's IT provider, delivering solutions for airlines, airports, aircraft, and governments. Their technology powers more seamless, safe, and sustainable air travel. 
 Job Summary: 
 We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Infrastructure Engineer/Endpoint Management Specialist to oversee and optimize our endpoint infrastructure. 
 This role will be responsible for managing workstations, laptops, and mobile devices across the organization, ensuring compliance, patching, software deployment, and endpoint security
 Key Responsibilities: 
 • Configure, manage, and maintain Endpoint Management Tools for comprehensive endpoint management. 
 • Analyse existing scripts and legacy systems to identify dependencies, variables, and overall architecture. 
 • Migrate and adapt legacy scripts and configurations to new endpoint management platforms while maintaining full functionality. 
 • Automate software deployment, patch management, and system updates for Windows, Linux and MDM environments. 
 • Monitor endpoint health and compliance; generate and analyze reports to identify trends and issues. 
 • Create and manage system images, OS deployment tasks, and remote troubleshooting operations. 
 • Deploy scripts (PowerShell, Bash, etc.) to automate routine maintenance and improve system efficiency. 
 • Ensure timely deployment of critical security patches and updates across all devices. 
 • Collaborate with the cybersecurity team to enforce endpoint security policies and device encryption. 
 • Provide Level 2/3 support for endpoint-related issues and escalate as needed. 
 • Document procedures, configurations, and support guides for internal use.
 Required Skills & Experience: 
 • 3+ years of experience in IT Systems Administration or Endpoint Management. 
 • Hands-on experience with endpoint management solutions. 
 • Script Knowledge: Ability to read, understand, and adapt legacy scripts (PowerShell, Bash) and their dependencies. 
 • System Migration: Experience seamlessly moving automation and configurations from old to new platforms. 
 • Proficient with patch management, software deployment, and remote desktop tools. 
 • Solid understanding of Windows and Linux operating systems. 
 • Familiarity with scripting languages like PowerShell, Python, or Bash. 
 • Knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, and network configurations. 
 • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. 
 • Knowledge of ITIL practices and ticketing systems. 
 • Experience with MDM and BYOD policies.
